result:
Both gates pass (`bun run typecheck` clean, `bun test` 9 pass / 0 fail), and `bunx guren check --ci` still reports 0 failures.

**Summary:** Posts now carry a `slug` column (`db/schema.ts`, migration `db/migrations/20260818101059_add_post_slug/` — the generated SQL was rewritten to add the column nullable, backfill existing rows with `post-<id>`, then rebuild the table with `NOT NULL UNIQUE`, since SQLite refuses a NOT NULL add on a populated table). `app/Models/Post.ts` gained an exported `slugify()` (NFKD + accent stripping, lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to single `-`, trimmed, falling back to `post`) and `Post.uniqueSlug()`, which fetches colliding slugs in one LIKE query and appends the next free `-2`, `-3`, …; `slug` stays out of `fillable`, so editing a title never moves the address. `routes/web.ts` registers `GET /posts/:id{[0-9]+}` → `PostController.showById` (301 to `/posts/<slug>`, 404 for an unknown id, with a fallback to a slug lookup so an all-digits slug is still served) ahead of `GET /posts/:slug` → `show`, which resolves via `Post.findWithOrFail(slug, 'author', 'slug')`; create/update redirect to the slug URL, while edit/update/delete stay id-based. `PostResource` exposes `slug` (so the post list, home page and search results carry it), `PostValidator` adds `PostSlugParamSchema`, the pages (`posts/Index.tsx`, `Home.tsx`) link to the slug URL, the posts seeder writes explicit slugs, generated files under `.guren/` were refreshed with `bun run codegen`, and the README's route list was updated. New tests live in `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covering slugify rules, duplicate-title numbering, the slug page and its 404, the 301 from the numeric address, the all-digits slug case, and slug stability across a title change.
